representative-to-congress-1.note: Counted by ranked choice (21-A MRS section 723-A); the votes shown are first choices. The leader had more than half of the first choices for the candidates and write-ins, a majority no later round could take away, so the leader is marked elected.

representative-to-congress-2.note: Counted by ranked choice. The votes shown are first choices. No candidate had more than half of them, so the Secretary of State's central count dropped Tiffany Bond and the write-ins after round 1; in round 2: Jared Forrest Golden 165,136, Bruce Poliquin 146,142. Jared Forrest Golden won (RCV Summary Report). The district's figures are the central count's first round; the town rows are the first choices as the municipalities tabulated them, which differ a little (Tiffany Bond: workbook 21,575, report 21,655; Jared Forrest Golden: workbook 153,023, report 153,074; Bruce Poliquin: workbook 141,205, report 141,260).

governor.note: The tabulation prints Cranberry Isles on 2 rows, with no other name for each; they are added together here.

register-of-deeds-aroostook-2.note: A second contest for this seat on the same ballot (the special county elections list names an unexpired term).

register-of-deeds-kennebec.note: The tabulation prints Augusta on 5 rows, with no other name for each; they are added together here.

register-of-probate-sagadahoc.note: Most of its rows do not satisfy candidates plus blanks equal ballots cast, so the number to elect cannot be worked out from the tabulation, and no winner is marked.
